description: Fetch a public web page's head and return link-preview metadata: title, description, site name, type, preview image, canonical URL, language, author, published time, favicon, theme colour, and every OpenGraph and Twitter-card field. Reads at most 512 KB and never runs JavaScript. Use to build link previews, label citations or check how a URL will unfurl before sharing it. Costs $0.001 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.

url.description: Absolute public http(s) URL of the page

name: url_meta
